test_policy.notes: ACT/SAT are not required for admission or scholarship consideration. Admission needs a 2.5 cumulative high school GPA, or ACT 22, or SAT 1120, or upper-half class rank, plus the college-prep curriculum. Scores can replace MSU's math placement assessment. International applicants who attended a US or Canadian high school are asked for official SAT/ACT scores.

requirements.notes: International online application (msuadmissions.com/international) with a $38 non-refundable fee ($30 on the paper form; never waived or deferred). Also needed: proof of English proficiency and the high school transcript (unofficial copies reviewed for admission, official required before registration). Financial certificate and bank statement are required for the I-20, not for the admission decision.

deadlines.label: International application deadline, fall 2027
deadlines.notes: July 1 for fall (spring Nov. 15, summer March 15); later applications may be considered case by case, and MSU encourages applying six months earlier. The page prints no year; treated as fall 2027. The CDS (C14) lists a 9/15 first priority date with rolling action afterwards.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Exempt: IB diploma; IGCSE O-level English C or above (or GCSE English 4+); 2 semesters or 24+ credits at a US regionally accredited college including two college English courses with C or better; the last 2 years at a US high school with B or better in English; a bachelor's, master's or doctorate from a US institution or a listed English-speaking country; or secondary school completed in a listed country with English-medium instruction. Also accepted: SAT EBRW 440 (Writing/Language 25+), ACT English 20+, APIEL 3, EIKEN Pre-1, or completing an intensive English program at a listed center (e.g. ELS level 112, EF C-1). Sub-scores are also considered.

english.notes: Page lists 'Internet-based TOEFL test (iBT): 4', which is the 1-6 scale; no 0-120 minimum is printed.
B2 First, C1 Advanced or C2 Proficiency.

aid.notes: International merit scholarship is automatic for fully admitted freshmen with a 2.5+ GPA: $5,000-$12,000 per year (tuition only), renewable with a 3.0 GPA and full-time status as a nonresident; transfers with 2.5+ get $7,000 per year. Not for conditional admits. The page says awards are based on GPA 'as of April 2, 2021', so amounts may have changed; confirm with the Office of International Programs. The MSU Presidential Scholarship (full admission required) has an application deadline in early December. English pathway: MSU's page lists completing an intensive English program at partner centers as an alternative to a test; no on-campus conditional admission is described.
